title: Public visibility flip — sensitivity sweep + gh repo edit
description: kb-projection is currently private (started private per the extraction plan). To flip public: (1) prose-pass on every committed file for sensitive references (paths, names, internal context); (2) review CHANGELOG + README for hygiene; (3) gh repo edit IanGordonOne/kb-projection --visibility public --accept-visibility-change-consequences. Engine code itself is unlikely to contain sensitive material based on extraction review, but a sweep before flip is the responsible move.
